name: Tenant Sharing
description: Counterpart on a tenant backend: lets an approved main RMM embed this backend and open it via auto-login. Pairing with confirmation - the tenant admin either issues a one-time pairing code or approves an incoming request. Active pairings control frame-ancestors for the approved main RMM addresses. The login runs through the normal sign-in; every user stores their credentials in the main RMM.
author: BYTERA

settings.label: Legacy: extra main RMM addresses
settings.help: Comma-separated, e.g. https://rmm.company.com. Optional - normally managed via pairings in the Tenant Sharing app. Empty = only approved pairings.
